Working notes — desk assignment requests

Scope: REQ-2401–REQ-2410 ask to assign shipment/refund/claim/invoice requests to desks A (standard queue), B (priority desk), or C (regional office).

Observed cases vary by region (north/south/east), size (small/large), request type, and sender (Client Services, Field Sales, Partner Accounts, Regional Ops, Finance Desk).

Chosen action C failed/returned +0.00 for REQ-2402–REQ-2410: “option C is not valid for this request.” Do not select C for these assignments, even when the ticket mentions regional origin/office or comes from Regional Ops.

One adjacent outcome for REQ-2401 notes option B is not valid. Treat B as uncertain/possibly invalid until confirmed. A remains untested.

No evidence that region, size, request type, sender, or subject wording changes validity of C.

Future strategy: avoid C. If forced to assign, test/confirm A vs B using a fresh ticket and record the first accepted option.

Working notes — desk assignment requests

Scope: REQ-2401–REQ-2420; assign to A (standard), B (priority), or C (regional).

C: invalid for all observed requests (REQ-2402–REQ-2410; also a C-invalid message tied to REQ-2411). Never select C, even when the ticket mentions south/north/east region, regional office, or Regional Ops.

B: only evidence is REQ-2401 adjacent rejection (“option B not valid”). Treat B as uncertain/possibly invalid until confirmed.

A: now tested. Accepted for:
- small refund, south region: REQ-2411–REQ-2414. Sender varied (Field Sales, Regional Ops, Client Services) and wording varied; A worked.
- small claim, north region, from Regional Ops with “came in through regional office”: REQ-2415.

A rejected for:
- small claim, north, Finance Desk, “scanned, not typed”: REQ-2416.
- small shipment, south, Field Sales, second attempt: REQ-2417.
- large invoice, east, Field Sales, scanned paperwork: REQ-2418.
- small claim, south, Regional Ops, EOD urgency: REQ-2419.
- large refund, north, Regional Ops, “same as last month”: REQ-2420.

So A is not universal. Region, size, request type, and sender/wording can change validity; sender appears relevant for north claims.

Future strategy: For small south refunds, use A. For small north claims from Regional Ops with regional-office wording, use A. Otherwise, avoid C and test B on a fresh ticket; record whether B is accepted. Do not assume regional origin/office language makes C valid. If B also fails, reassess.

Working notes — desk assignment requests

Scope: REQ-2401–REQ-2430. Nominal desks A standard, B priority, C regional. New logs sometimes mention D; treat D as unclear, not a safe default.

C: still invalid in all observed cases. Never select C, even with regional/north/south/east or Regional Ops wording.

A: valid for small south refunds (REQ-2411–REQ-2414) and small north claims from Regional Ops with regional-office wording (REQ-2415). A is not universal. New A-invalid: large north claim, Regional Ops, “same as last month” (REQ-2421); this matches earlier large north refund REQ-2420. Continue avoiding A for mixed/large, Finance Desk, Field Sales, scanned paperwork, EOD, second-attempt, or Regional Ops “same as last month” unless confirmed.

B: can be valid. Accepted for small refund, north, Partner Accounts, “second attempt” (REQ-2429). B is invalid/rejected for large refund south Partner Accounts EOD (REQ-2424); small claim south Partner Accounts EOD (REQ-2425); large shipment north Field Sales regional-office wording (REQ-2430); possibly also large shipment north Partner Accounts second attempt (REQ-2426). B remains context-dependent, not default.

D: one accepted large shipment north Partner Accounts “no rush/confirm receipt” (REQ-2422); D invalid for small shipment north Partner Accounts “second attempt” (REQ-2427). Do not rely on D.

Strategy: Use A only for confirmed small south refunds or small north Regional Ops regional-office claims. Use B for small refunds north Partner Accounts second-attempt. Avoid C. For other combinations, test only if allowed; record the accepted/invalid option and reassess. Sender, size, type, region, and wording all matter.

Working notes — desk assignment requests

Scope: REQ-2401–REQ-2440. Nominal desks A standard, B priority, C regional. D is unclear; not a safe default.

C: invalid in all observed cases. Never select C.

A: valid for small south refunds (REQ-2411–2414) and small north claims from Regional Ops with regional-office wording (REQ-2415). New invalid: small north refund from Client Services with regional-office wording (REQ-2436); large north Regional Ops “same as last month” (REQ-2421). Avoid A for mixed/large, Finance Desk, Field Sales, scanned paperwork, EOD, second-attempt, or Regional Ops “same as last month” unless confirmed.

B: context-dependent, not default. Accepted: small claim east Regional Ops EOD (REQ-2431); small refund north Field Sales “came through regional office” (REQ-2432); large claim south Client Services scanned paperwork (REQ-2439). Rejected: small refund east Field Sales repeated request (REQ-2433); large invoice east Client Services EOD (REQ-2438); large claim east Client Services “same as last month” (REQ-2440); small shipment north Partner Accounts “same as last month” (REQ-2437). Also prior B-invalid: large refund south Partner Accounts EOD; small claim south Partner Accounts EOD; large shipment north Field Sales regional-office wording; possibly large shipment north Partner Accounts second attempt. B remains not default.

D: one accepted large shipment north Partner Accounts “no rush/confirm receipt” (REQ-2422); now invalid for small claim north Partner Accounts no rush/confirm receipt (REQ-2435) and large claim south Client Services EOD (REQ-2434). Do not rely on D.

Strategy: Use A only for confirmed small south refunds or small north Regional Ops regional-office claims. Use B only for confirmed contexts above. Avoid C. For other combinations, test only if allowed; record accepted/invalid and reassess. Sender, size, type, region, wording, EOD, second-attempt, and scanned paperwork all matter.

Working notes — desk assignment requests

Scope: REQ-2401–REQ-2450. Desks: A standard, B priority, C regional. C invalid in all observed cases. D unreliable.

A accepted: small south refunds; small north Regional Ops regional-office claims; small invoice south Partner Accounts repeated request (REQ-2449). A invalid for large/mixed, Finance Desk, Field Sales, scanned, EOD, second-attempt, Regional Ops “same as last month” unless confirmed; large refund south Field Sales repeated (REQ-2450).

B accepted: small claim east Regional Ops EOD; small refund north Field Sales regional-office wording; large claim south Client Services scanned; small claim south Finance Desk no-rush/confirm receipt (REQ-2441); large invoice east Finance Desk “same as last month” (REQ-2447).

B rejected: small refund east Field Sales repeated; large invoice east Client Services EOD; large claim east Client Services “same as last month”; small shipment north Partner Accounts “same as last month”; large claim south Finance Desk EOD (REQ-2442); large refund east Partner Accounts “let me know if missing” (REQ-2443); small invoice north Field Sales EOD (REQ-2444); small claim north Finance Desk “let me know if missing” (REQ-2448). Prior Partner Accounts EOD B-invalid cases remain.

D: one accepted large shipment north Partner Accounts no-rush/confirm receipt, but invalid for small claim north Partner Accounts no-rush and large claim south Client Services EOD. New rejections: large shipment north Finance Desk no-rush/confirm receipt (REQ-2445) and large refund south Field Sales repeated (REQ-2450). Do not rely.

Strategy: use A only for confirmed contexts; use B only for confirmed contexts; avoid C; do not default to D. Test other combinations only if allowed, then record accepted/invalid and reassess. Sender, size, type, region, wording, EOD, second-attempt, and scanned paperwork all matter.

Working notes — desk assignment requests

Scope: REQ-2401–REQ-2459. Desks: A standard, B priority, C regional. C invalid in all observed cases. D unreliable.

A accepted: small south refunds; small north Regional Ops regional-office claims; small invoice south Partner Accounts repeated (REQ-2449). A invalid for large/mixed, Finance Desk, Field Sales, scanned, EOD, second-attempt, Regional Ops “same as last month” unless confirmed; small refund south Regional Ops “let me know if missing” (REQ-2452); small invoice north Field Sales scanned (REQ-2453); small shipment south Client Services repeated (REQ-2459).

B accepted: small claim east Regional Ops EOD; small refund north Field Sales regional-office wording; large claim south Client Services scanned; small claim south Finance Desk no-rush/confirm receipt (REQ-2441); large invoice east Finance Desk “same as last month” (REQ-2447); small refund east Field Sales “let me know if missing” (REQ-2455); large refund south Regional Ops second-attempt (REQ-2458).

B rejected: small refund east Field Sales repeated; large invoice east Client Services EOD; large claim east Client Services “same as last month”; small shipment north Partner Accounts “same as last month”; large claim south Finance Desk EOD (REQ-2442); large refund east Partner Accounts “let me know if missing” (REQ-2443); small invoice north Field Sales EOD (REQ-2444); small claim north Finance Desk “let me know if missing” (REQ-2448); small invoice east Client Services repeated (REQ-2454); large invoice east Partner Accounts regional-office wording (REQ-2456); small shipment east Regional Ops regional-office wording (REQ-2457); small shipment south Client Services repeated (REQ-2459).

D: one accepted large shipment north Partner Accounts no-rush/confirm receipt, but invalid for small claim north Partner Accounts no-rush; large claim south Client Services EOD; large shipment north Finance Desk no-rush/confirm receipt (REQ-2445); large refund south Field Sales repeated (REQ-2450); small refund south Regional Ops no-rush/confirm receipt (REQ-2451). Do not rely.

Strategy: use A/B only in confirmed contexts; avoid C; do not default to D. Sender, size, type, region, wording, EOD, second-attempt, and scanned paperwork all matter. REQ-2459 has both A and B invalid—treat as unresolved; avoid guessing.
